stem: Which statement best describes cell theory?

options.label: A
options.text: Cells are part of complex organisms that work together to produce new cells.

options.label: B
options.text: Cells perform a single life function, and most cells come from existing cells.

options.label: C
options.text: Cells use energy from food to be able to perform life functions and work together to produce new cells.

options.label: D
options.text: Cells are the basic unit of structure for all organisms, and all cells come from existing cells.
